name: doctor

render.note: the rig ships at 1920x1080; the post crops in hard so it is rendered at 4K

layers.note: head excludes the mouth (25): mouth shapes are composited on and must travel with the head. Bangs (26) stay in the head plate - separating them exposes an outline the rig hides behind the main hair.

face.note: face width is measured at the lip line. Only 74px from lip to collar, so open mouths must fit inside that.

eye_note: flat cream discs on black, no pupils. Blinks squash them vertically and the black behind fills in. No gaze is possible.
mouth_note: as a fraction of face width. Sized larger than ~0.65 the mouth is wider than his face and touches the edges.
vowel_hold_note: vowels whose shape is held while still audible, so a decaying note does not snap shut mid-word. Applied to every vowel it leaves the mouth open ~90% of the time.

tears.note: x pairs are start and end. Routed down the OUTER cheeks: straight down from either eye runs through the mouth, which spans x1881-1959.

crop_note: generous enough that head movement never reaches the edge
capability_note: gaze needs pupils, which this rig has none of. hair_lag is impossible: the 4 bangs drawings are view angles, not sway, and offsetting them exposes an outline.
